biblical_reference.note: Ishael was a son of Jabesh-gilead who was the only survivor of the battle between Jabesh-gilead and the Ephraimites. He was given the name Ishael, which means 'God is my reward,' because the people of Jabesh-gilead had paid him for his services with silver.

Furthermore, the name is reminiscent of other biblical names, such as Isaiah and Ishmael, linking it to a long-standing history and faith tradition.
